locator.title: 90% покупателей вторички не знают об этом риске
locator.lead: Подробно разбираем, как банкротство продавца может лишить вас квартиры
locator.caption: Проверить продавца на долги можно на сайтах ФССП и ЕФРСБ бесплатно. Но эти базы покажут только уже возбуждённые дела

nearest_text_before.text: Человек продаёт квартиру. Покупатель проверяет документы, и, на первый взгляд, всё чисто. Сделка проходит, право собственности зарегистрировано. А через год продавец подаёт на банкротство. Финансовый управляющий поднимает все сделки за последние 3 года и находит вашу. Если цена в договоре ниже рыночной или сделка выглядит подозрительно, её оспаривают (ст. 61.2 закона 127-ФЗ).

nearest_text_after.text: Почему этот риск не видно заранее

image_reading: A thoughtful man sits at a desk with an open laptop, looking down at its screen.
His contemplative posture and focused gaze communicate careful review of information; the laptop remains the clear focal object.
analysis.article_context: This body image follows the explanation that a seller’s bankruptcy risk is often invisible in standard documents and introduces the practical need to check the seller for debts through public databases, while acknowledging that such checks have limits.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Careful review of available information is necessary when assessing a seller’s hidden financial risk before a secondary-market property deal.
structured_intent.primary_action: The man gradually settles his attention onto the laptop screen.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The man is visibly and steadily focused on the laptop screen with an intent, concerned expression.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: He remains thoughtful and concerned while evaluating potentially incomplete information.

models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, keep the desk composition stable as his attention settles progressively onto the laptop. Use a restrained downward head-and-eye adjustment and a subtle increase in concentration, with no hand movement or speech. The fixed shot ends with him clearly studying the screen in sustained concern.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. The man gradually lowers his gaze more firmly to the laptop screen, his expression tightening into quiet concentration; by the final frame he is steadily focused on the laptop, thoughtful and concerned.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second interpretation, let the visible man gradually commit his attention to the laptop through a small, natural head inclination and focused eyes. Keep his pose otherwise steady and preserve the uneasy analytical tone through the end; the final moment shows an unbroken, intent review of the screen.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed shot as the man’s attention settles on the laptop, his expression becoming more intent. End with him quietly focused on the screen, maintaining a concerned, analytical mood.

models.scene_plan: Over four seconds, use one compact attention shift: the man makes a subtle forward-and-downward adjustment toward the laptop while his gaze becomes more concentrated. Keep the camera still and the existing pose stable. Finish near the end with his eyes anchored on the screen and the same thoughtful concern intact.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera. The subject subtly inclines toward the laptop and narrows his focus on the screen. In the final frame he remains quietly intent on reviewing it, with a concerned analytical expression.
